verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers global payments across 150+/190+ countries in 40+ currencies with mid-market/competitive FX rates, no transfer/wire fees, and stablecoin rails for fast settlement, directly matching the finance-lead's need to pay internationally in local currency with transparent fees. Evidence spans multiple product pages (global accounts, cross-border payments, instant pay) describing fee structures, FX conversion, and settlement speed, though all is vendor-authored docs without independent/third-party corroboration. Missing for 10: independent verification of actual fee transparency/rates and real customer confirmation of no hidden fees.
